title: Hold a pipeline licence
what: Construct or operate a pipeline only as (or for) the registered holder of a pipeline licence.

sources.title: Pipelines Act 1967 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person shall not operate a pipeline— (a) unless the person is, or is acting on behalf of, the registered holder of a licence and the operation is in pursuance of the licence,
